beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book’s optimism depends on these choices instead of treating them as automatic consequences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Start with the opening chapter, which deliberately presents conclusions before the demonstration.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then choose one essential service and follow its physical, industrial, and social requirements.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The appendices show how estimates were constructed and how their assumptions should be read.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The remaining-scarcity chapters keep the promise of enough distinct from a promise of everything.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book offers readers a way to evaluate abundance claims without choosing optimism blindly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its central test is whether productive possibility becomes secure access for actual people.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read the full argument to judge that passage, where technical promise becomes a social decision.
